Messages.Author: ResurrectioN
Messages.Body:
I have 2 questions regarding this card:

Summon Spirit Beast
Type: Combat / Reaction
Requires: Spiritus/Animalism
Cost: X blood
[ani] [COMBAT] Discard X cards.
[spi] [COMBAT][REACTION] Move X animal retainers from your ash heap to
this vampire, with life from the blood bank equal to their starting
amounts. After this minion phase ends, burn those retainers.
[SPI] As [spi] above, but the retainers are not burned until after the
end of your next minion phase.

1. If A wants to play card at spi/SPI, does that mean that he acctuay
has to play it in combat that occured douring B's turn?
(eg. He couldnt play it before blocking (as reaction only card).
He cant pay it in combat douring his turn )

2. Can retainers accuired by this method be burned with Pack Alpha for
efects of + x to strenght?

I think its NO on both questions but i have to prove it to others.

Thanks.

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
ResurrectioN wrote:
> I have 2 questions regarding this card:
>
> Summon Spirit Beast
> Type: Combat / Reaction
> Requires: Spiritus/Animalism
> Cost: X blood
> [ani] [COMBAT] Discard X cards.
> [spi] [COMBAT][REACTION] Move X animal retainers from your ash heap to
> this vampire, with life from the blood bank equal to their starting
> amounts. After this minion phase ends, burn those retainers.
> [SPI] As [spi] above, but the retainers are not burned until after the
> end of your next minion phase.
>
> 1. If A wants to play card at spi/SPI, does that mean that he acctuay
> has to play it in combat that occured douring B's turn?
> (eg. He couldnt play it before blocking (as reaction only card).
> He cant pay it in combat douring his turn )
>

When a card is played, it is only ever one cardtype. At spi/SPI, he can
play it as either a Combat card or a Reaction card.

> 2. Can retainers accuired by this method be burned with Pack Alpha for
> efects of + x to strenght?
>

Yes. No card text indicates otherwise.

--
- Gregory Stuart Pettigrew

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
JJeff wrote:
> Sorry, random rather wierd question with rgards to the card.

Top-posting makes it hard to follow conversations.

> How does the ani part of the card work with Hukros?

Like any other discard, it cannot be Hukros's card. Hukros's card can
only be played (and then only by Hukros). It cannot be discarded
indepently (although it would burn if Hukros is burned, of course).
